client_id.description: The ID is autogenerated and immutable.

client_name.description: The human-readable name of the client to be presented to the end-user during authorization.

client_secret.description: The secret will be included in the create request as cleartext, and then never again. The secret is kept in hashed format and is not recoverable once lost.

client_uri.description: ClientURI is a URL string of a web page providing information about the client. If present, the server SHOULD display this URL to the end-user in a clickable fashion.

metadata.description: Key value pairs for registering with the client.

permissions.description: The permissions to always grant this specific client

items.description: The permissions to always grant this client

roles.description: The roles to always grant this specific client

items.description: The role names that will be expanded to include required permissions

owner.description: Owner is a string identifying the owner of the OAuth 2.0 Client.

policy_uri.description: PolicyURI is a URL string that points to a human-readable privacy policy document that describes how the deployment organization collects, uses, retains, and discloses personal data.

refresh_token_grant_access_token_lifespa.description: Specify a time duration in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours.

refresh_token_grant_id_token_lifespan.description: Specify a time duration in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours.

refresh_token_grant_refresh_token_lifesp.description: Specify a time duration in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours.

client_credentials_grant_access_token_li.description: Specify a time duration in milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours.

scope.description: Scope is a string containing a space-separated list of scope values (as described in Section 3.3 of OAuth 2.0 [RFC6749]) that the client can use when requesting access tokens.

sector_identifier_uri.description: URL using the https scheme to be used in calculating Pseudonymous Identifiers by the OP. The URL references a file with a single JSON array of redirect_uri values.

skip_consent.description: SkipConsent skips the consent screen for this client. This field can only be set from the admin API.

tos_uri.description: A URL string pointing to a human-readable terms of service document for the client that describes a contractual relationship between the end-user and the client that the end-user accepts when authorizing the client.

userinfo_signed_response_alg.title: UserInfoResponseAlgo
userinfo_signed_response_alg.description: The algorithim to use when returning user info. Switching to RS256 will return a signed JWT token. By default this is the return.
